sector_strength.methodology: Existing TRL leadership score: 50% return rank, 30% turnover rank, 20% advancing share. Calculated within the source candidate group.

trend_score.methodology: Existing TRL leadership method combines turnover acceleration, index-relative return, position versus the five-day moving average and proximity to a three-month high.

capital_flow_change.methodology: Planned comparison of foreign and institutional net buying across comparable completed Korean sessions, with coverage reported separately.
